items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: That's why Walter Winchell said both orchids to Louis Armstrong and his Orchestra, this time.

ctx.x: That's why Walter Winchell said both orchids to Louis Armstrong and his Orchestra, this time. This was not that bad, and they played the original Old Man Mose, and not the one that the publishers revamped and messed up.
Oh, what was that? I know Louis made a record in '35 in New York named Old Man Mose, and there was something --
